summary.ja: 既存配布版：実対称正定値な連立一次方程式を共役方向で反復的に解く。公開例は単位正方形・零Dirichlet Poisson方程式の五点差分を、行列を組み立てずに扱う前処理なしCG。 追加固定例：係数ジャンプ拡散：共有流束とMG・AMG、回転異方性拡散：完全テンソルQ1とMG・AMG。条件と検証範囲は各配布版で確認してください。
summary.en: Existing releases: Solve real SPD linear systems by conjugate directions. The public example is unpreconditioned matrix-free CG for the five-point zero-Dirichlet Poisson operator on a unit square. Additional fixed examples: Checkerboard diffusion: shared flux, MG and AMG, Rotated diffusion: full-tensor Q1, MG and AMG. See each release for assumptions and checked scope.

code_mapping_scope: Scoped fixed-input examples; original method variants and earlier releases remain distinct.

references.label: Hestenes, M. R. & Stiefel, E. (1952). Methods of Conjugate Gradients for Solving Linear Systems.
references.scope: Real SPD conjugate-gradient recurrence; not the heat time integrator used elsewhere in the chapter.

supports.ja: 実対称正定値系に対するCGの反復式と、丸め誤差がある場合の有限回終了の限界。
supports.en: CG recurrence for real SPD systems and the qualification of finite termination in floating-point arithmetic.

verification.locator: Sections 2–3, especially (3:1) and the discussion of rounding error, pp. 410–411.

assumptions: The operator must be real SPD and the right-hand side finite; the example discretizes constant-coefficient −Δu=f on a uniform square grid.
Inner products are Euclidean array products; the current implementation starts from zero and has no preconditioner.
poisson_comparison.solve stops on a recomputed true relative residual; linear.poisson_2d uses a recurrence residual with tolerance×max(1,initial residual).
units: CG has no intrinsic physical unit. The public Poisson coordinates have unit dimensionless length; dimensionally [f]=[u]/[length]². Residual norms are unweighted array norms.
boundary_conditions: CG itself supplies no physical boundary condition. The public 2D Poisson examples impose u=0 on every side of [0,1]² by zero padding.

limitations.ja: 既存配布版の制約：非対称・不定・特異な系にそのまま適用しない。前処理、一般疎行列入力、純Neumannの零空間処理はこのCG例にはない。小さい残差は離散化誤差の保証ではなく、単一固有モードの速い終了を一般的性能と解釈しない。 今回の追加固定例：係数比100の固定例。P1格子差は厳密誤差上界ではなく、特異交点の次数や普遍的なMG/AMG優劣は主張しません。 指定した角度・異方性の限定例。スカラーTPFAを回転テンソルへ転用せず、一般テンソルへの頑健性は保証しません。
limitations.en: Limits of existing releases: Do not apply this variant directly to nonsymmetric, indefinite or singular systems. This CG example has no preconditioner, general sparse-matrix interface or pure-Neumann nullspace handling. A small residual does not certify discretization accuracy; rapid termination for one eigenmode is not a general performance result. Additional fixed examples: Fixed contrast100 example. P1 differences are not rigorous error bounds; no singular exponent or universal MG/AMG winner is asserted. One angle/anisotropy only. Scalar TPFA is not extended to rotated tensors; arbitrary-tensor robustness is not established.

metadata_review.level: method-specific sources and implementation inspected; no new numerical rerun

supplemental_review.level: Frozen fixed-input source,independent review,actual pytest/main and independently extracted ZIP; see each new release for exact reference independence and failed-attempt history.

assumptions_ja: 作用素は実対称正定値で、右辺は有限。ここでは定係数の −Δu=f を一様正方格子で離散化する。
内積は配列成分のEuclidean内積。既存実装の初期値は零で、前処理は用いない。
poisson_comparison.solve は再計算した真の相対残差を停止に使う。linear.poisson_2d は反復残差と tolerance×max(1,初期残差) を使う。
units_ja: CG自体に固有の物理単位はない。公開Poisson例は長さ1の無次元座標で、次元を与えるなら [f]=[u]/[長さ]²。残差は格子体積で重み付けしない配列ノルム。
boundary_conditions_ja: 代数解法としてのCGは境界を定めない。公開2次元Poisson例は [0,1]² の全辺で u=0 をゼロ埋め込みにより課す。

problem.ja: Poisson方程式の離散化などから得られる、実対称正定値系 Ax=b。
problem.en: Real SPD systems Ax=b, including a discrete Poisson equation.

variant.ja: 五点差分作用素を直接適用する前処理なしの線形CG。共通比較経路では各反復で真の残差を再計算する。
variant.en: Unpreconditioned linear CG with a matrix-free five-point operator; the comparison path recomputes the true residual each iteration.

ja: SPDが分かっている離散系で、行列積だけから解を求めたいとき。
同じ格子・右辺・真の残差基準で他のPoisson解法と比較するとき。
en: The discretized system is known to be SPD and a matrix-free solve is desired.
Comparing Poisson solvers on the same grid, forcing and true-residual criterion.

ja: 移流による非対称系、鞍点系、零空間を残した周期・Neumann系。
反復回数だけで計算時間や連続解の精度を保証したい場合。
en: Nonsymmetric advection systems, saddle-point systems or periodic/Neumann systems with an untreated nullspace.
Claims about runtime or continuous-solution accuracy based only on iteration count.

reason.ja: CGの再帰式、前処理の有無、二つの停止条件をコードで区別した。
reason.en: Inspected the CG recurrence, absence of preconditioning and two stopping rules.

reason.ja: 単位正方形と配列ノルムの規約を明記した。
reason.en: Specified the unit-square and array-norm conventions.

reason.ja: CGの固有要件ではない。公開例の零Dirichlet条件は別途明記した。
reason.en: Not intrinsic to CG; the examples' zero-Dirichlet condition is separately stated.

reason.ja: SPDの要件と既存例の範囲に限定した。
reason.en: Limited the claim to the SPD requirement and existing examples.

summary.en: Inspected linear.poisson_2d, poisson_comparison.solve and existing tests for general-forcing discrete residuals, matched stopping criteria and the single-mode case; no rerun.

scope.ja: 単位正方形のsin(πx)sin(πy)を参照し、CG/MGは15/31/63内部点、P1 FEMは4/8/16分割で細分化。FDの最大誤差と真の残差、FEMの要素内L2誤差とH1半ノルムを独立に評価する。
scope.en: Reference sin(πx)sin(πy) on the unit square; refine CG/MG through 15/31/63 interior nodes and P1 FEM through 4/8/16 subdivisions. Independently evaluate FD maximum errors/true residuals and FEM element-interior L2/H1-seminorm errors.

method_note.ja: この問題に明示的に結び付けられた補助実行例と、存在する場合は共通実行例の手法です。別問題の配布物を借用していません。 SEMはC0連続なテンソル積Qp Lagrange基底・p+1個のLegendre GLL節点と求積、疎な剛性行列・SciPy直接解法を使用。p=2で各方向2/4/8要素、別に2×2要素でp=1〜6。公開済みNumartのP1 FEM・GMRESをファイルのバイト列を保持して4/8/16分割で実行し、両者の自由未知数9/49/225を一致させます。
method_note.en: Methods from explicitly bound supplementary examples and, where present, the common execution example. No release for a different problem is borrowed. C0 tensor Qp Lagrange SEM with p+1 Legendre GLL nodes/quadrature, sparse stiffness assembly and a SciPy direct solve. At p=2 use2/4/8 elements per axis; separately fix2x2 elements and p=1..6. Execute the byte-identical published Numart triangle P1 FEM/GMRES at4/8/16 subdivisions, matching9/49/225 free unknowns.
